market trends to support business growth.

      ESG MANAGEMENT                                                             ESG管理方針

      ESG Concept                                                                ESG理念

      We believe that sustainable and robust ESG performance is essential        我們相信持續穩健的ESG表現對本集團
      to the sustainable development of the Group ’ s business and the           業務與本集團所在社區的可持續發展至
      community where the Group operates. The dynamic combination of             關重要，商業和社會需求的有機結合方
      commercial and social needs is bound to embrace more influential           能產生更具影響的社會效應。我們不僅
      social effects. We are not only committed to achieving sound financial     致力於實現強健的財務業績，亦致力於
      performance but also realizing greater overall benefits through            積極識別各利益相關方的期望，不斷發
      actively identifying stakeholders ’ expectations, discovering areas        掘自身業務發展和環境、社會需求的契

Focusing on Food Safety                                                      專注食品安全

Food safety is the basis of food consumption. It is the responsibility       食品安全是食品消費的基本要求，保障
of all food enterprises to ensure the safety and reliability of food. As a   食品的安全可靠是所有食品企業的責

            applying the Group’s accounting policies.                                   計政策時作出判斷。

            based on historical experience and other factors, including                 於歷史經驗及其他因素，包括對未

            on the entity and that are believed to be reasonable under the              實體造成財務影響且據信在某些情
            circumstances.                                                              況下屬合理。

                  Net realisable value of inventories is the estimated selling                存貨的可變現淨值按日常業務
                  price in the ordinary course of business, less estimated costs              過程中的估計售價減估計完工
                  of completion and the estimated costs necessary to make                     成本及作出銷售的估計必要成
                  the sale. These estimates are based on the current market                   本計算。該等估計乃基於當前
                  condition and historical experience of manufacturing and                    市況以及製造及銷售類似性質
                  selling products of similar nature. Management reassesses                   產品的過往經驗作出。管理層
                  these estimates at each balance sheet date.                                 於各資產負債表日期重估該等

             The Group allocates the consideration in the contract to the                     分。本集團根據其相對獨立的

             stand-alone prices. However, for leases of real estate for                       及非租賃部分。然而，就本集

             lease and non-lease components and instead accounts for                          言，其已選擇不區分租賃及非

      8.    LEASES (Continued)                                                        8.   租賃（續）

            (iv)   Accounting policies of leases (Continued)                               (iv)   租賃會計政策（續）

                   Lease terms are negotiated on an individual basis and                          租賃條款乃按個別基準磋商，
                   contain a wide range of different terms and conditions. The                    並包含各種不同的條款及條
                   lease agreements do not impose any covenants other than                        件。除出租人所持租賃資產的
                   the security interests in the leased assets that are held by                   擔保權益外，租賃協議並無施
                   the lessor. Leased assets may not be used as security for                      加任何契諾。租賃資產不得用
                   borrowing purposes.                                                            作借款擔保。

                   The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate                      租賃付款額按照租賃內含利率
                   implicit in the lease. If that rate cannot be determined, the                  折現。如果無法確定該利率，
                   lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is used, being the rate                    則應採用承租人的增量借款利
                   that the individual lessee would have to pay to borrow                         率，即個別承租人為在類似經
                   the funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value in                     濟環境下獲得價值相近的資
                   a similar economic environment with similar terms and                          產，以類似條款和條件借入資
                   conditions.                                                                    金而必須支付的利率。

                   To determine the incremental borrowing rate, the Group:                        為釐定增量借款利率，本集
                                                                                                  團：

                   •     where possible, uses recent third-party financing                 •      在可能情況下，使用個別承租
                         received by the individual lessee as a starting point,                   人最近獲得的第三方融資為出
                         adjusted to reflect changes in financing conditions                      發點作出調整以反映自獲得第
                         since third party financing was received,                                三方融資以來融資條件的變
                                                                                                  動，

                   •     uses a build-up approach that starts with a risk-free             •      使用累加法，首先就本集團所
                         interest rate adjusted for credit risk for leases held                   持有租賃的信用風險（最近並
                         by the Group, which does not have recent third party                     無第三方融資）調整無風險利
                         financing, and                                                           率，及

                   •     makes adjustments specific to the lease, e.g. term,               •      進行特定於租約的調整，例如
                         country, currency and security.                                          期限、國家、貨幣及抵押。

                   Right-of-use asset are generally depreciated over the shorter           使用權資產一般於資產的可使用年
                   of the asset’s useful life and the lease term on a straight-            期及租賃期（以較短者為準）內按直
                   line basis. If the Group is reasonably certain to exercise a            線法予以折舊。倘本集團合理確定
                   purchase option, the right-of-use asset is depreciated over             行使購買選擇權，則使用權資產於
                   the underlying asset’s useful life.                                     相關資產的可使用年期內予以折舊。

                   Payments associated with short-term leases are recognised               與短期租賃相關的付款按直線法於
                   on a straight-line basis as an expense in profit or loss. Short-        損益確認為開支。短期租賃指租賃
                   term leases are leases with a lease term of 12 months or less           期為12個月或以下的租賃且並無購
